Package SWProject

Class OrderService

java.lang.Object
SWProject.OrderService
public class OrderService extends Object
Core business logic service responsible for managing food orders. Handles order validation, GPS-based auto distance calculation, dynamic pricing strategies, polymorphic order creation (Standard, Express, Scheduled), order cancellations, and order querying.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Adham, Ahmad

    • placeOrder

      public SWProject.Order placeOrder(SWProject.User customer, int restaurantId, String deliveryAddress, List<OrderService.CartItem> cart, String orderType, String scheduledTime)
      Places a new food delivery order with validations, GPS-based auto distance calculation, dynamic pricing, and polymorphic order type rules (US2.1, US2.2, US2.3, US4.2, US4.3, US5.1, US5.2).
      Parameters:
      customer - the user placing the order (contains latitude and longitude coordinates)
      restaurantId - the ID of the selected restaurant
      deliveryAddress - the delivery text address
      cart - the list of selected cart items and quantities
      orderType - the requested order type ("STANDARD", "EXPRESS", or "SCHEDULED")
      scheduledTime - the requested delivery time for scheduled orders
      Returns:
      the saved Order object if successfully placed, or null if rejected

    • placeOrder

      public SWProject.Order placeOrder(SWProject.User customer, int restaurantId, String deliveryAddress, List<OrderService.CartItem> cart)
      Overloaded placeOrder method for backward compatibility (defaults to "STANDARD" order type and "ASAP").
      Parameters:
      customer - the user placing the order
      restaurantId - the ID of the restaurant
      deliveryAddress - the delivery text address
      cart - the list of cart items
      Returns:
      the created Order object if successful, or null if rejected
